description: Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT): electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). Coverage: Instituto de Estadística de las Islas Baleares (IBESTAT). The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Distribució percentual de producció d'energia elèctrica per període, i; Demanda d'energia elèctrica per període i illa. Des de 1999M01 a 2026M; Proporció d'energies renovables en la producció d'energia elèctrica; Establiments segons el tipus de contracte de subministrament elèctric.. Formats seen: JSON, PC-AXIS, CSV, XML, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
